_about: Curated, VERIFIED MCA supplement: IP-specific MSCOD meanings, generic MCACOD meanings, and RAS recovery-class behaviour. Complements the bank->IP maps (bank_mapping_*.json) and the bulk mca_codes_database.json. Only values confirmed from the source docs / user are stored — placeholders (e.g. CHA TOR_TIMEOUT code, COR) are intentionally left unresolved, never guessed.
